== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[AT-RT (Errata 3)]] (<code>1291_71</code>, Virtual Block 9.1 slip 9), showing the '''PC-E3''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. Power 1.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p895797 by darkjediknight11, 25 July 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p895797
* '''PC-E3 text:''' “May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot). May move as a 'react.' Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. "T-47" on [Hoth] weapons may be treated as "AT-RT".”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E3 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB9-03-AT_RT-PC-E3-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
